nodes.label: stamp_versions.py
nodes.description: CI/dev utility that stamps product version strings. Reads a canonical VERSION file (one semver line) and propagates the version into sdk/mcp/server.py serverInfo.version via regex substitution. Also keeps the PyPI-bundled copy (sdk/python/hipcortex/install/mcp_server.py) in sync with the canonical MCP server. Supports --print, --mcp, --check (dry-run), and --version override modes.

nodes.label: Continue.dev Context Provider README
nodes.description: Installation and usage guide for the HipCortex Continue.dev context provider. Documents: 2-step setup (copy provider + add to config.json), starting the HipCortex server (binary or managed hipcortex.fly.dev), usage patterns (@hipcortex queries, /remember and /recall slash commands), and environment variables (HIPCORTEX_URL, HIPCORTEX_API_KEY, HIPCORTEX_ACTOR).

nodes.label: index.ts (Continue.dev provider)
nodes.description: Continue.dev context provider implementation for HipCortex. Implements the BaseContextProvider interface to inject persistent memory into Continue.dev conversations. Exposes HipCortexContextProvider (get()) which searches memory and returns ContextItem[], and HipCortexSlashCommands (remember/recall generators). Communicates with the HipCortex REST server via fetch to /memory/search and /memory/add.

nodes.label: index.ts (TypeScript SDK entrypoint)
nodes.description: Public entrypoint for the HipCortex TypeScript SDK. Re-exports HipCortexClient class and all TypeScript type definitions from ./client and ./types respectively.

nodes.label: client.ts (TypeScript SDK)
nodes.description: Synchronous (fetch-based) TypeScript HTTP client for the HipCortex REST API. Constructor accepts HipCortexClientOptions (baseUrl, apiKey, timeout). Core memory methods: addMemory, queryMemory, search, bulkAdd, forget, health, stats, coherenceStatus. Intelligence layer: liveBeliefs, reflect, predict, rollout. Graph/TMF (v0.4.0): linkMemories, getNeighbors, searchRelated, deleteMemory. Convenience helpers: addHumanMessage, addAiMessage, getConversationHistory, canExecute. Uses AbortController for per-request timeout.

nodes.label: types.ts (TypeScript SDK)
nodes.description: All TypeScript interface definitions for the HipCortex SDK. Covers the full API surface: core memory (AddMemoryRequest with record_type enum, MemoryRecord, AddMemoryResponse, QueryParams, QueryMemoryResponse, SearchRequest/Response/Result, BulkAddRequest/Response, ForgetResponse, StatsResponse, CoherenceStatusResponse, HipCortexClientOptions), TMF graph types (LinkMemoriesRequest/Response, NeighborsResponse, RelatedSearchResponse, DeleteMemoryResponse, RolloutRequest/Response), and intelligence layer types (LiveBeliefsResponse, ReflectRequest/Response, PredictRequest/Response).
